title: ADMINISTRATOR L3
description:
Job description:
  
  
Job Description

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Design, implement, and maintain observability solutions using tools such as Datadog, Splunk, ELK/Elastic Stack, Prometheus, or Grafana.
* Develop and optimize dashboards, alerts, and reports to provide actionable insights into system health and performance.
* Aggregate, parse, and analyze logs and metrics from various sources.
* Collaborate with development, operations, and support teams to define monitoring requirements and improve system reliability.
* Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to monitoring, logging, and alerting.
* Participate in incident response, root cause analysis, and post-incident reviews.
* Stay current with industry trends and best practices in observability and monitoring.

**Required Skills:**

* Experience with one or more observability platforms (Datadog, Splunk, ELK, Prometheus, Grafana, etc.).
* Strong understanding of monitoring, logging, and alerting best practices.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and their monitoring services.
* Experience with Application Performance Monitoring (APM) tools.
* Knowledge of distributed systems and microservices architectures.
* Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
* Strong communication and collaboration abilities.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Scripting or programming skills (Python, Bash, PowerShell, etc.).
* Familiarity with ITSM/ITIL processes.
* Experience with automation and infrastructure-as-code tools.
* Automate observability processes and integrate with CI/CD pipelines.

Mandatory Skills: AIOPS - Implementation .

Experience: 3-5 Years .

Reinvent your world. We are building a modern Wipro. We are an end-to-end digital transformation partner with the boldest ambitions. To realize them, we need people inspired by reinvention. Of yourself, your career, and your skills. We want to see the constant evolution of our business and our industry. It has always been in our DNA - as the world around us changes, so do we. Join a business powered by purpose and a place that empowers you to design your own reinvention.

title: DevOps Engineer - WAS and Automation
description:
**About The Job**
At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine mission-critical technology systems with expertise and AI-powered insights. This role focuses on middleware administration, automated workflows, and DevOps pipeline management.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain automation solutions for middleware platforms using Ansible, Python, and YAML.
* Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, and Jenkins.
* Manage and support enterprise middleware environments including IBM WebSphere Application Server, Tomcat, and WebLogic across development and production.
* Automate deployment and configuration of middleware workloads on Microsoft Azure and hybrid infrastructures.
* Implement proactive monitoring, logging, and automated remediation for middleware components.

**Requirements**
**Requirements**

* Experience with middleware technologies including IBM WebSphere Application Server, IBM Liberty, and Apache Tomcat.
* Proficiency in automation and configuration management tools such as Ansible and Python.
* Hands-on experience with CI/CD platforms like Azure DevOps and GitHub Actions.
* Knowledge of cloud platforms like Microsoft Azure and container tools like Docker and Kubernetes.

**Skills**
AnsiblePythonAzure DevOpsWebSphere Application ServerDockerKubernetes
  
  
**Benefits**

* Learning & development
* Wellness programs

title: DevOps Engineer fresher
description:
- Assist in managing Linux servers and cloud infrastructure.

- Support the setup and maintenance of CI/CD pipelines.

- Deploy and monitor applications on cloud platforms.

- Work with Docker containers and Kubernetes.

- Automate routine deployment and operational tasks.

- Monitor system performance and troubleshoot issues.

- Manage source code using Git and GitHub/GitLab.

- Collaborate with Development, QA, and Operations teams.

- Maintain technical documentation and deployment procedures.

- Follow DevOps best practices related to automation, security, and monitoring.

 Requirements
   

  

- Basic knowledge of Linux/Unix

- Understanding of Networking (DNS, HTTP, IP, SSH)

- Git \& Version Control

- CI/CD Concepts

- Basic AWS/Azure/GCP knowledge

- Docker and Containerization

- Bash/Shell or Python Scripting

- Problem\-Solving and Troubleshooting Skills
